name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) with Precedence(blocker_moved, door_open), Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) captures both required orders, forces blocker_moved and has_door_key through the chain, and requires the box pickup.

texts: The blocking ball is moved at some point before the door is unlocked.
The agent acquires the matching key before the door is unlocked.
The door is unlocked before the box is picked up.
The mission's target box is eventually picked up.
